    # Selector for the last position

    last_zero = rasp.Aggregate(select_last, all_zero, default=False).named("last_zero")

    # The sequence is balanced at each position iff:
    # - all balances are non-negative up to that position
    # - all balances are zero at the last position
    return (all_non_negative & last_zero).named("shuffle_dyck")
